desc: The Stalker Carbon Hunter features a NiB coated bolt carrier assembly for reliability under harsh hunting conditions; Brenton's own 3.5-6.5 lbs. Performance Grade Trigger assembly for custom tunability; HuntSize controls for use with gloved hands; MarbleKote camouflage for concealment; free-floating performance grade barrel, threaded for suppressor use with black nitride protective barrel coat; Magpul MOE fixed stock; black Hogue Hunter grip; Bi-pod/sling mount and carbon fiber reinforced RealFeel handguard for use on bi-pods and tripods. Includes soft case, Neoprene camo handguard cover and 5rd magazine.
